statement: For the preceding choices, every nonzero homogeneous hI ∈ RI of positive degree satisfies (4.3) lcto(C0; hI) ≥ 1 2n(I/a) . Every nonzero regular local function g on V and every divisorial or real quasi-monomial valuation w centred at o satisfy (4.4) w(g) ≤ 2nAθV (w) v(g). Moreover, for every valuation w centred at o, (4.5) w(g) ≥ s(w)v(g) (g ∈ OV,o), s(w) = min i w(hi) v(hi) . In particular each positive normalized homogeneous degree is at least 1/(2n).
